text:
Samir: noticed BERTScore dropped ~4 points after quantized-v2 bring-up, same eval harness, different tokenization behavior.
Maya K: hmm, is it the tokenizer change or the model export? :thinking:
Samir: ran quick bisect, looks like tokenizer vocab ordering changed when we applied the byte fallback patch. quantized float->int8 export preserves the new vocab indices but our metric runner still uses the old token map.
Jordan L: ugh, token index drift will wreck bscore if the detok differs. do we have a failing example? paste minimal repro?
Samir: pasted below — example target vs pred detokenized diff from CI run:
```
TARGET: "Turn on the lights in the kitchen." 
PRED:   "Turn on the light in kitchen."
BLEU: 0.61, ROUGE-L: 0.78, BERTScore: 0.56 -> expected ~0.60
```
Samir: note the subtle spacing and "the" dropped; token-level alignment changed.
Maya K: did the eval runner snapshot the tokenizer? our CI image still had tokenizer v1 pinned, but model was exported with v2.
Samir: exactly. CI logs show model metadata lists tokenizer_hash=abc123_v2 but runner used cached tokenizer abc123_v1.
Natalie (eng-ml): eval-bot reported flaky bscore on quantized lanes yesterday too. CI failure:
```
ci-bot: pipeline failed: eval-runner/bscore-smoke (exit 1)
reason: metric delta > threshold (bscore -0.041)
```
Samir: short-term fix: update runner to auto-load tokenizer from model metadata if present, fall back to pinned snapshot only with warning.
Jordan L: agreed. long-term: add token-normalization layer in metric wrappers so BERTScore and BLEU operate on detokenized normalized strings (strip extra spaces, join punctuation) to reduce fragility.
Maya K: can add a unit test that compares detok outputs between tokenizer versions and asserts normalized equality for benign changes.
Natalie (eng-ml): I'll own a small patch: (1) runner change to prefer model tokenizer, (2) add normalization helper, (3) add CI test and a dashboard anomaly marker for tokenizer drift.
Samir: awesome. also let's add a short-lived fallback route in the rollout policy: if bscore drops >0.03 with identical prompts, fallback to float model variant.
Jordan L: added task in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/182
Maya K: will review. also suggest a small metric calibration note in the docs: quantized exports can change detok -> affects lexical/semantic metrics.
Samir: good call. Natalie, can you add a one-liner explainer in the metrics docs and a recommended checklist for onboarding new tokenizers?
Natalie (eng-ml): will do. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Samir: thx — marking thread resolved once PR merges and CI green. :white_check_mark:
eval-bot: rerun scheduled: eval-runner/bscore-smoke (retrigger by @Natalie)
Maya K: thanks all, nice quick triage :rocket:
